module_summary: 4-to-1 parallel-to-serial converter: a 2-bit counter reloads a rotating shift register from d every fourth cycle, emitting its MSB serially with a valid pulse on load.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: 4-bit parallel word loaded into data when cnt reaches 3.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Rotating shift register serializing d MSB first.

anchors.name: dout
anchors.why: Serial output bit, MSB of data shift register.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: Pulse marking first serial bit of a new word, copy of valid.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Bit counter selecting load versus shift and generating valid.

groups.name: serializer
groups.description: Loads parallel word and rotates out MSB each cycle.

groups.name: bit_counter
groups.description: Counts four bits per word and pulses valid on reload.
